claim: § Ratios + What the ear hears as the index rises: whole-number ratios keep the harmonic series and anything else leaves it (bells), and raising the index shimmers rather than simply brightens.

pieces.section: What the ear hears as the index rises
pieces.what: The existing seven-step staged patch: one operator, then the pair, the index sweep, the ratio, feedback, up to the DX7 keyboard.
Nudge the ratio from 1:1 to 1:1.003 to 1:1.414 and hear harmonic, beating, then bell, with the spectrum showing partials leave the harmonic grid.
Algorithms 1, 5 and 32 as technical diagrams, as the page's own forward vector asks.
One operator with its feedback pushed from 0 to 7 and past, sine to saw to noise.

gathered: FM Synthesis — proof — staged patch checks.mjs (the checks, not for the face)
